artworks.title: Gerrit de Jong
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man standing confidently. His left hand is on his hip and his right hand holds a decorative staff. He has short, curly hair, high cheekbones, and a sharp gaze. The man wears a detailed outfit with a high collar, patterned jacket, puffed trousers, a sash, tights, ornate shoes, and a sword at his hip. The background features a detailed landscape with plowed fields, sparse vegetation, and distant hills. There is text at the bottom in a script-style font.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene in a cave with animals and gifts being offered. The drawing depicts figures in varied positions around a central scene that includes an adult figure holding a child with halos above their heads. Around them are individuals presenting objects to the central figures. To the left, more figures are gathered, including a procession towards the scene. In the background, there are architectural elements such as stone buildings and an archway, with a radiant celestial body illuminating the scene from above. The lines are carefully etched, providing a detailed and textured depiction.

artworks.title: Pietà (The Sorrowing Virgin with the Dead Christ in Her Lap)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the foreground. The first figure is a man lying down, looking lifeless. The man has long hair and a beard, and is partially covered with a cloth. The second figure is a woman seated to the man's left. She is dressed in layered clothing and has a cloth covering her head. The woman's eyes are closed, and she is touching the man's torso. Both figures are surrounded by a radiant aura. In the background, there are hills, distant figures, a cross, and a city silhouette. Beside the figures, there is a crown of thorns on the ground.

artworks.title: Georgiana (Spencer), Duchess of Devonshire
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing on a stone balustrade. She is positioned in the center, with her body slightly leaning to the right. Her right hand is on the rail, and her left hand is by her side. She has fair skin, delicate facial features, and an aristocratic appearance. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with a large feather and possible jewelry. She wears an elegant, flowing gown with rich fabric and intricate details. The background features trees, a cloudy sky, and a sculpture on a pedestal in a manicured garden. The scene conveys a serene and refined atmosphere blending nature and classical architecture.

artworks.title: William Innes
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Lemuel Francis Abbott
artworks.description: The image shows two men in full-length view standing in an outdoor setting. The man in the foreground stands facing slightly to the side and holds a golf club over his shoulder. He has a smooth face and is wearing a large-brimmed hat, with light curly hair visible underneath. He is dressed in a 18th-century-style outfit: a buttoned jacket with ornate shoulder decorations, knee-length breeches, and tall socks tucked into buckle shoes. The man in the background stands behind him with a more relaxed posture. He has longer hair under a tricorn hat and wears a long coat while holding multiple golf clubs. The background features an expansive landscape with a large house, fields, and a windmill, bordered by a wooden fence. The sky appears cloudy, providing a classic, serene backdrop to the scene.

artworks.title: Henry Laurens
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after John Singleton Copley
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a chair. He is facing slightly to the side, one arm resting on a table, and the other on the back of the chair. The man has a composed expression, soft facial features, and a prominent nose. His hair is styled in a formal manner typical of the 18th century. He is dressed in elaborate attire, including a tailcoat, waistcoat, breeches, stockings, and shoes with buckles. A ruffled white shirt is visible under his coat sleeves. On the table beside him, there are various objects including rolled-up papers with writing, a quill pen, an inkpot, and closed books. He holds a long staff or cane. The background includes thick drapery with tassels and a column, and in a faded section, a landscape with trees can be seen.

artworks.title: The Wright Family (The Bradshaw Children)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an outdoor setting. The first person, a young woman, is seated on the ground, facing right, holding a lamb. The second woman is seated next to her, also facing right. A young boy is seated to the right of the women, looking up. There is a tree in the left background and a cloudy sky in the right background.

artworks.title: George Washington
artworks.artist: Valentine Green, after Thomas Stothard, after Charles Willson Peale

artworks.title: The George Inn, Beaconsfield
artworks.description: The image features a low, street-level view of an alleyway between old buildings. The horizon is obscured by the structures, with tiled roofs creating a jagged line against the sky. Birds are seen in flight. The pen and ink drawing uses precise lines to depict building textures and cobblestones. The color palette is black ink on cream-colored paper. In the foreground are two figures, alongside barrels and a covered cart. Details like shingles, bricks, and wood emphasize the historic atmosphere.

artworks.title: St. Mary's College, St. David's
artworks.description: The image shows historical ruins next to a waterway. The view is from a slightly elevated position, showing detailed stone structures and a large tower. A stream is in the foreground, reflecting the surroundings. The scene includes ancient walls, arches, and windows, with trees adding contrast. The artwork is mainly black and white, emphasizing fine details and creating a sense of history.

artworks.title: St. Ippolyts, No. 2
artworks.description: The image displays a tall church building surrounded by trees. The viewpoint is slightly looking up to emphasize the building's height. The horizon is not clearly visible. The artwork uses an etching style with stippling for shadows. The color palette is monochrome with black on light paper. A pathway curves through the scene with a small figure sitting on it.

artworks.title: Stevenage
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a flock of sheep being herded along a dirt path. The sheep are shown grazing or moving forward, while a lone shepherd leads them. The path is lined with lush trees, and the horizon line is low with a clearing in the distance. The sky above contains wispy clouds. The artwork is done in black ink on a pale background, creating a serene rural ambiance.

artworks.title: Garden House
artworks.description: The image shows a small building, likely a chapel. It is positioned centrally in the artwork, with a slightly elevated perspective. The lush trees surround the building. The structure has a hexagonal roof, a small decorative piece at its peak, and a tall cylindrical chimney. The tree foliage is detailed with soft pencil strokes, while the building has structured lines emphasizing its architectural details. Paved stones lead to the entrance, framed by geometric hedges. The color palette includes shades of black and grey.

artworks.title: Apse of St.-Didier, Avignon
artworks.description: The image shows a street view looking up at a large stone church with a tall spire dominating the composition on the right side. The street recedes into the distance, creating a vanishing point where the buildings meet the sky. Delicate pencil strokes give texture and depth to the drawing. People are walking along the street, providing scale against the architecture. The color palette is primarily shades of gray, enhancing the texture and shadow of the elements. Additional buildings and a streetlamp are visible in the background.

artworks.title: North Marston Church
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a ground level perspective of a grand, historic building resembling a church or cathedral. The structure features a tower with battlements, gothic windows with intricate tracery, and detailed stonework, all depicted through an etching technique with fine lines. The color palette is primarily sepia tones. In the foreground, there is a path with two figures walking towards the building, surrounded by shrubbery.

artworks.title: Cloitre St. Pierre, Avignon
artworks.medium: red and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a city street view facing a grand historic building with Gothic architectural elements, such as pointed arches and a stone facade. A large leafless tree stands in the foreground, its bare branches intermingling with the building's spire. Behind the tree, there are buildings along the street leading to the main structure. The fine brushstrokes or pencil lines depict intricate details of the stone and brick, creating a detailed and delicate texture. The color palette is muted with shades of grey and brown.

artworks.title: Landscape with Castle
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a grove of tall trees on the left and a stone castle in the distance. There are birds flying above the castle. The castle is depicted in sunlight streaming through the clouds. The color palette is monochromatic with varying intensities of pencil shading. The sky appears calm and clear.

artworks.title: Topiary Archway
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective from a pathway leading to a grand brick archway flanked by two tall structures. The horizon is obstructed by the archway, revealing a building with an arched window in the background. The drawing is detailed with pencil shading to depict depth and texture on the stone and foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of gray and black. Lush trees line the path, framing the central structure.

artworks.title: St. Anne's Church from Southover
artworks.description: The image is a drawing viewed from a downward perspective, looking down a narrow, winding street. Close to us, on either side, are buildings with distinct textures, one with vertical planks and the other with brick details, showcasing well-defined lines and precise cross-hatching techniques that provide depth and texture. The horizon line is low, and in the distance, it features the silhouette of a church with a pointed spire amongst lush trees. This view extends from a shaded foreground leading up to the brighter area in the distance. The image has a monochromatic color palette, using black ink on a cream-colored paper, emphasizing the contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Sunset and Moonrise at Cilian-Aeron
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a shaded path winding through a wooded area. The perspective is slightly elevated, with trees filling most of the composition. The trees on either side form a canopy with dense foliage drawn in intricate strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, using only black and white to enhance contrast and depth. The shading close to us is detailed, creating a patterned effect on the path. In the distance, the path narrows and fades into the landscape.

artworks.title: Cain Killing Abel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a physical struggle. The scene includes a barren tree, rocky formations, and swirling cloud details in the background. The drawing features intricate line work and a high level of detail.

artworks.title: Two Apprentices Fighting
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with two figures grappling and various objects scattered around. The drawing portrays a classical architectural setting with columns and arches in the background. The two central figures are engaged in what appears to be a struggle, with one possibly wielding a bladed object. The foreground is filled with various items such as a bucket, tools, a shield or lid, and a small fire with smoke curling upwards into the air.

artworks.title: Isabel de Borbon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated on a horse in an empty landscape. The person is sitting upright on the horse, facing slightly to the right, with one hand raised as if holding the reins. The individual has prominent facial features, with a composed gaze and dark hair styled delicately. They are wearing an ornate, floor-length garment with intricate patterns and a high collar or wrap around the neck. The person is holding the reins of the horse, which is adorned with a decorated bridle. The horse is shown in an impressive stance, matching the dignity of its rider.

artworks.title: Isabel de Borbon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated elegantly on a horse. The person is positioned side-saddle on the horse, facing the viewer with one hand holding the reins. They have a composed demeanor with a delicate and youthful face and short hair styled away from the face. The person is dressed in an opulent robe or dress with intricate patterns, suggesting high status. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects. The background is a simple landscape with open land.
